description.p: Infiltrator Software provides one coherent surface for discovering, installing, updating and repairing software while keeping package-system mechanics isolated behind replaceable backend contracts.

The Linux implementation merges verified Infiltrator catalogue records, host AppStream applications and configured Flatpak metadata while presenting Discover, Installed, Updates, System, Repositories, History and Repair in one application.
Reduces maintenance brittleness with shared Debian parsing, narrower GUI ownership, verified offline build assets and simpler packaging/release boundaries.
Reduces build and release brittleness with tracked-source archives, package-derived architecture identity and narrower build dependency propagation.
Reduces build and UI coupling by making the Common gitlink authoritative and removing stale direct engine dependencies from the graphical application.
